title: Diabetes Insight Analyzer
summary: A Kedro-based student ML project for diabetes data processing and model training (logistic regression, AutoGluon, random forest) served via a FastAPI app. Its diabetes pipeline uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic diabetes records from a database-fetched dataframe.
evidence: src/diabetes/synthetic_data.py: metadata.detect_from_dataframe(df); model = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata); model.fit(df); synthetic_data = model.sample(len(df))
